summary: Iteration 31: Successfully tested TikTok-style camera page and service worker v4. All camera UI elements render correctly - sidebar with Voltear/Belleza/Efectos/Timer, mode selector (Foto/15s/60s), filter carousel, large capture button. Post-capture mode shows Filtros/Stickers/Texto edit sidebar, Retake/Caption/Publish controls. Service worker v4 serves correctly with Safari cache fix (network-first for HTML, updateViaCache: 'none').

critical.issue: Endpoint does NOT exist - camera page BrunoCameraPage.jsx line 461 calls /api/posts/upload but backend only has /api/upload/image. Publishing from camera will fail.

integration_issues.issue: BrunoCameraPage.jsx uses /api/posts/upload endpoint which doesn't exist. Should use /api/upload/image then /api/posts

action_items: Fix camera publish flow: Change /api/posts/upload to use /api/upload/image for media upload, then /api/posts for creating the post
